description: Returns a published wedding vendor by its slug, including services, descriptions, FAQs, ratings, photos and website links. The result states whether the description, services, FAQs and price band were generated by Aisle from public information or supplied by the vendor, whether the vendor chose its category, and where the rating comes from.

slug.description: Unique slug identifying a published Aisle vendor.
